decisions.reason: The online customer portal is distant from the firm's display know-how, so it is less able to interpret its results, but it supports the one-stop service and fits the push for information security, so it is likely refined rather than dropped.
The packaging display builds directly on the firm's cardboard design expertise and won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, clear validated evidence the firm can assimilate and exploit commercially.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display sits close to the core display business, where in-house design and R&D let the firm read market feedback and adapt it, and its own page signals ongoing commitment.
The counter display is a standard format squarely within existing knowledge and capacity, so it is cheap to maintain and easy to improve from customer feedback.
The freestanding information display uses the firm's established printing and construction competencies and broadens the 3D cardboard offering it is heading toward.
